state_definitions.NOT_ACQUIRED: Physical artifact archive has not been downloaded or staged on disk.
state_definitions.NOT_VERIFIED: Physical bytes or metadata exist on disk, but cryptographic SHA-256 integrity or upstream provenance remains unverified.
state_definitions.VERIFIED_INTEGRITY: Physical file bytes exist on disk and exactly match an authoritative cryptographic checksum. (CRITICAL: Proves byte identity only, not legal or copyright permission).
state_definitions.REQUIRES_REVIEW: Integrity or licensing metadata is cataloged, but legal rights clearance, work-level boundaries, or pretraining compatibility remain pending formal review.
state_definitions.EXCLUDED: Source is permanently barred from ingestion due to confirmed copyright, privacy, licensing, or ethical policy violations.
state_definitions.APPROVED_FOR_DEFINED_USE: Source has satisfied all 6 dimensions: verified byte integrity, archived license evidence, work-level eligibility, affirmative legal training clearance, safe redistribution, and quality approval for an explicitly defined bounded scope.

allowed_transitions.required_evidence: Physical retrieval of candidate artifact bytes to staging storage.
Cryptographic computation of SHA-256 byte digest matching upstream signed/authoritative release digest.
Archival of physical license evidence document with verified SHA-256 and initial engineering governance review.
Identification of irreconcilable copyright risk, non-commercial restrictions, unconsented PII, or fatal licensing incompatibility.
Formal legal counsel written review, work-level boundary verification, attribution notice verification, and bounded pilot/pretraining scope ratification.
